message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is typically **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods it’s **10 hours behind**.  

| Period | LA offset | Berlin offset | Difference |
|--------|-----------|---------------|------------|
| Standard (winter) | UTC−08:00 | UTC+01:00 | −9 h |
| Daylight Saving (summer) | UTC−07:00 | UTC+02:00 | −10 h |

So if it’s noon in Berlin, it’s 3 a.m. (standard) or 4 a.m. (daylight) in Los Angeles.
